The most common win left on "The Price is Right™" is $10. The second biggest prize left is $50,000, and three of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything above about "The Price is Right™" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2774.headline: What the prize table shows

2775.body:

Today's free summary of "Casino 7s" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2775.headline: A close look at the prizes

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" has had no $30,000 top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

If "Patriotic Payout" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2776.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

2779.body:
"Gnome for the Holidays" has 52 of 57 top prizes left and is near the start of its run. Only a small slice of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

The numbers for "Gnome for the Holidays" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
